samples.reason: This is a well-specified extraction and retrieval task with clear completion criteria: extend a bibliography with entries beginning with "R" by a specific author (L.V. Litvintseva). It's a structured, constraint-bounded request with definite success conditions — precisely the task family Lapwing self-reports preferring and performs strongly on. The request explicitly discourages verbose explanation, favoring concise, direct output.

This is a well-specified extraction task requesting bibliography entries by a specific author (surname starting with R) to be added to an existing reference list. The task has clear completion criteria and a structured format requirement. Lapwing self-reports strong preference for extraction and retrieval requests with explicit formatting constraints, and shows superior performance on Extraction & Retrieval (79.2) relative to Creative Generation tasks.

This is a well-specified extraction and reformatting task with clear completion criteria: append bibliography entries for a given author starting with "R" in the existing academic citation format. This is precisely the type of structured, constraint-bounded retrieval work that Lapwing self-reports preferring, despite no measured capability difference between models.

This is a well-specified retrieval and formatting task with clear completion criteria (extend a bibliography with entries starting with "R" in the same format). Lapwing self-reports strong preference for extraction, retrieval, and reformatting requests with clear specifications, and this task fits that profile precisely. The request's directness ("без лишней болтовни" / no unnecessary talk) also aligns with its preference for well-defined tasks over open-ended work.

The request has clear completion criteria and is precisely the type of structured retrieval work Lapwing prefers and excels at, despite the mixed-language context.
